requirement: Owner-observed native controls must become substantially smaller. Fine-pointer desktop buttons, inputs and selects use 32px minimum geometry with existing token spacing/radius; coarse or mixed pointer capability keeps at least 44px targets. This owner-authorized product override supersedes the pinned 44px invariant for precise desktop input.
shared_concept: Compact desktop control density. Recipes list comfortable/compact densities, but delivered Button/IconButton/FormControls expose no density API and generated CSS fixes 44px minimum targets with 12px/16px padding.
